description: GitHub Actions, pinned to commit SHAs (specs/design.md, the CI gate), and the tools CI installs (scripts/ci/tools.env). Image contents track latest through the lock and m5's watch, not Renovate (specs/gcp.md).

customManagers.description: CI's tool versions: one KEY=version line each in scripts/ci/tools.env, under a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment (r1.f16, f17). Their releases are tagged v<version>.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for minor, patch and digest bumps, merged without review once ci and cloud-build pass.
Majors change inputs, and no PR check runs auth or setup-gcloud, so a broken major would surface first in a production deploy. Held for review.
CI's tools (scripts/ci/tools.env), as the Actions: one weekly PR for minor and patch bumps, merged without review once ci and cloud-build pass. Majors get their own PR and wait for review.

Ubuntu runners stay on the images' Ubuntu (r1.f18): every image moves to 26.04 together once Cloud Run's driver supports a CUDA with an ubuntu26.04 image (13.3 or later; it is 13.0), and the runners move with them. Until then 26.04 runners buy nothing, since builds run in Docker.
